speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. To help me narrow down the cause, have you noticed any fever or chills? When did these symptoms start?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID). The combination of dysuria, severe abdominal pain, vomiting, and a history of inconsistent condom use with dyspareunia strongly suggests an ascending infection involving the upper genital tract. I am requesting a urine analysis and a pelvic ultrasound to confirm the presence of pyuria and identify any adnexal abnormalities.
